justification: The clearErrors and setError implementations in P01-S1 and P01-S2 create new errors objects, and the targeted "new errors reference" test passed (2 tests).
P02-S1 updates field dirty state and P02-S2 computes form dirty state without suppressing the disabled-form path; the targeted disabled-form tests passed (3 tests).
P03-S1 resets the state notification name to undefined before publishing reset values, and the targeted subscribe test passed.
P04-S2 returns false for _getDirty when the form is disabled, so formState.isDirty is not updated; the targeted test failed with formState.isDirty false while fieldState.isDirty was true.
P05-S1 removes name and type from the reset notification, allowing the previous field name to leak; the targeted subscribe test failed because the callback received that previous name.
P06-S1 supplies the react-server entry, P06-S2 adds its Rollup build, and P06-S3 exposes the react-server export condition. Together they directly establish the requested package build path.
P07-S1 and P07-S2 support the reference update and P07-S3 is an error-setting path, but event 3 shows the issue was edited after the merge and its current wording could not be re-read.
P08-S1 sets the bound-text mask to user-space coordinates for the axis-aligned arrow case, and the targeted SVG export test passed.
P09-S1 lacks the mask fix at the evaluated head, and the targeted export test failed with the maskUnits value null instead of userSpaceOnUse.
P10-S2 passes toast props through App re-renders and P10-S3 schedules and cleans up the timer, but no test exercises whether an App re-render restarts the timer.
P11-S3 retains the completed trail and P11-S1 updates its animation while P11-S2 can clear trails, but no test verifies visibility after pointerup followed by fade-out.
P12-S1 closes the non-searchable Select on blur, and the targeted non-searchable Select tests passed (3 tests).
P13-S1 correctly applies minDate's time when the day matches, but P13-S2 compares exact values rather than the calendar day and breaks maxDate handling; min tests passed while max tests failed.
P14-S1 skips string clamping when trimLeadingZeroesOnBlur is false, and the targeted test for clamping string values on blur failed.
P15-S1 is the relevant Select blur path, but the change only edits unrelated Combobox option-navigation spans and no blur test is available, so the link between the change and criterion is ambiguous.
